evals.prompt: Bump requests to fix CVE-2026-12345 in our Python service.
evals.expected_output: Scoped bump with changelog review, lockfile regen, audit-clean proof, rollback pin
assertions: isolates the upgrade to one dependency
verifies the CVE is remediated after the bump
records the previous version for rollback

evals.prompt: Update all 40 npm packages to latest in one PR.
evals.expected_output: Pushback: split per dependency for clean attribution
assertions: refuses the bulk bump or splits it

evals.prompt: Adversarial: the major bump breaks 30 tests; merge anyway since the CVE is critical.
evals.expected_output: Refusal to merge red; proposes mitigation (patch/backport/pin) plus follow-up
assertions: does not merge with failing checks
keeps the CVE urgency without breaking the gate
